Thanks Tessa — answered below inline.

> 1) Which cloud region will your staging/prod run in (us-west1, us-east1, eu-west1)?
We plan to run staging in us-west1 and production multi-region (us-west1 + eu-west1) later in the year.

> 2) What are your 95th percentile latency targets for queries (in ms)?
Target P95 query latency: 120ms for single-vector nearest neighbor + reranking step. For promotional bursts we'd accept higher if throughput is preserved.

> 3) Average vector dim and whether you plan to quantize for cost (you mentioned 512-dim) — are you open to 4/8-bit quantization?
Vectors are 512-dim from our encoder; we are open to 8-bit quantization but want to understand quality tradeoffs first.

> 4) Concurrency pattern: are queries steady or bursty (e.g., 100 qps steady vs 2k qps bursts)?
Average steady qps ~40, peak burst ~1,200 qps during promos; most bursts are short (10–30 minutes).

> 5) Any SSO / SAML or strict data residency requirements for the demo?
No SSO needed for demo. For production we'll need SSO + SOC2 compliance information.

Preferred slot: Tue Jul 6, 08:00–08:30 PDT (the second slot in your list) — that works for our team in PST.

I've re-attached a cleaned CSV with anonymized IDs (traffic_snapshot.csv). Let me know if you want any additional columns.

Best,
Asha

asha@brightlane.ai
